output.action: Aminata tells Moussa she will come to the celebration.
output.explanation: She is exhausted and needs to study, but Moussa has helped her before without asking repayment, and she has previously attended work-related gatherings when the goodwill mattered. Her memory of being made to serve tea and walking home late makes her cautious, but her stronger pattern is to preserve useful neighborhood ties when they may support her later, so she agrees rather than refuse outright.
